documents.detail: Students’ Guide and Code of Conduct, revised January 2023. Printed page 148: course grades; page 149: degree classifications; page 150: CWA calculation. No separate November 2025 revision found. Confirmation that these rules applied to the November 2025 Computer Engineering cohort is still pending.

funding_screen.title: Chevening
funding_screen.detail: Two years after degree completion and 2,800 post-degree work hours required. Your degree was completed in 2025.

funding_screen.title: DAAD EPOS
funding_screen.detail: Requires at least two years of relevant professional experience after the first degree at application. This is specific to EPOS, not every DAAD award.

funding_screen.title: ASU Mastercard Foundation
funding_screen.detail: 2027/28 technology scholarship deadline has passed, despite a broad partner directory showing applications open.

items.title: Referee requests and application pack
items.detail: Your official transcript is procured and recommendation letters are in progress. Confirm two academic and one professional referee; send each the CV, official transcript, grading key, programme list, submission instructions and a requested return date of 30 November. Tell referees to use institutional email where portals require it.

items.title: Check Sciences Po Mastercard eligibility
items.detail: KNUST is on the eligible institution list. Check the Ghana minimum academic threshold, age rule and English test requirement immediately. Later scholarship/admission round closes 14 December; complete recommendations and required test evidence are mandatory. The programme is a two-year technology-policy Masters, not a core CS MSc; independently write the scholarship essays.

items.title: ETH Zurich MSc and ESOP go/no-go
items.detail: Confirm whether you can credibly self-assess within the top 10% required for ESOP, choose the exact MSc, and finish an independently authored thesis pre-proposal. Do not rely on ESOP without eligibility evidence.

items.title: Complete first referee-ready application packet
items.detail: Finalize programme-specific CV, transcript scan, degree certificate, grading key, English-medium letter request and referee brief. Submit referee requests with portal-specific instructions and deadlines.

items.title: ETH ESOP application deadline
items.detail: ETH international MSc/ESOP application closes 11:59 AM CET (10:59 AM Ghana). Submit only if eligibility and all independently authored materials are ready.

items.title: Purdue Computer Science MS deadline
items.detail: Fall 2027 application deadline. Confirm referee submission timing and English evidence in the portal; complete only if the full application can be submitted by the programme deadline.

items.title: Cambridge Mastercard safe funding target
items.detail: Cambridge official sources list conflicting dates (2 and 8 December). Use 2 December as the safe target. Assess whether your Sankofa recycling project and future goals support a genuine climate/sustainability impact case. Requires full course application and scholarship statement.

items.title: Referee follow-up and missing documents
items.detail: Follow up politely with any referee who has not submitted. Check that each portal shows the reference received; do not assume an invitation email means the letter is submitted.

items.title: AUC, UBC CS and Saskatchewan application deadlines
items.detail: AUC Fall 2027 early graduate admission deadline, UBC CS thesis MSc deadline, and published Saskatchewan September-entry deadline. Submit separate complete applications; confirm each portal’s exact supporting-document and reference deadline. AUC MCF early funding target is 1 February 2027 (date conflict noted).

items.title: CYBERSURE Erasmus Mundus deadline
items.detail: Confirm official transcript, two academic references and English evidence; check non-EU document and test-score rules.

items.title: Oxford MSc Advanced Computer Science deadline
items.detail: Submit by noon UK/Ghana time for October 2027. This also triggers automatic Clarendon consideration if eligible; funding is highly competitive.

items.title: EDISS Erasmus Mundus deadline
items.detail: Complete consortium application, English evidence and academic references; verify the 2027 scholarship terms.

items.title: AUC Mastercard early funding target
items.detail: Conservative early target from AUC scholarship application instructions. AUC Mastercard FAQ separately says 1 April 2027 priority; confirm cycle instructions and submit the scholarship financial assessment.

items.title: IPCVai Erasmus Mundus deadline
items.detail: Proceed only if computer vision is a real study interest; engineering degree and English-medium evidence are accepted per consortium guidance.

items.title: Cambridge MPhil course deadline
items.detail: Final course deadline; Mastercard funding application should target 2 December due conflicting funding dates.

items.title: AUC Fall 2027 regular admission and Mastercard priority date
items.detail: AUC Mastercard FAQ names 1 April as priority for Fall 2027 graduate applicants. Complete graduate admission, scholarship application, financial assessment and English evidence; compare with AUC scholarship guide’s separate Feb/June dates.
